name: Dark Ambient
description: Long, dark reverb for evolving drones.

name: Small Room
description: Short damped reverberation with a subtle wet mix.

name: Large Hall
description: Longer open reverberant tail for sustained sounds.

name: Soft Chamber
description: A medium-length, warm tail with a restrained wet mix.

name: Bright Ambient
description: A long, lightly damped tail emphasizing the input's upper harmonics.

name: Long Wash
description: A near-maximum decay for a sustained wash; leave mixing headroom.

name: Wet Texture
description: Fully wet reverberation for a parallel texture lane; retain dry audio elsewhere.

name: Subtle Glue
description: A low wet level to add a little shared ambience to a mixed drone.
